metaDescription: Capability catalogue for ISB Security Platform — reporting, objects, personnel, operations, security governance and intelligence by development stage.
title: Operational capability, structured by domain.
intro: ISB Security Platform is built as a modular operational system. Capabilities are grouped by domain but share the same organizational, object, access and audit context.
maturityNote: Development maturity labels, not commercial availability: Foundation established · Active development · Discovery / architecture · Planned · Future / research.

reporting.title: Structured operational documentation
reporting.body: Reporting and recovery are in active development. AI-assisted drafting requires human review and does not make operational decisions.

specificReport.name: Specific Report
specificReport.purpose: Targeted operational reports with structured fields.

aiAssisted.name: AI-Assisted Specific Report
aiAssisted.purpose: Draft structuring from field input under mandatory human review.

attachments.name: Attachments & Photos
attachments.purpose: Files attached to reports. Not immutable evidence custody.

organizations.title: Multi-customer operational structure
organizations.body: One security provider may manage several customers while maintaining separate operational context.

clientReporting.name: Client-facing reporting
clientReporting.purpose: Client-facing reporting workflows. Not a released portal product.

objects.title: Hierarchical site model
objects.body: Objects and locations are in active development. Document publication authority is in discovery, not an available publishing control.

tree.building: └ Building / Floor / Zone · access · patrol context

documents.name: Document workspaces
documents.purpose: Object-linked documentation. Publication authority is in discovery.

personnel.title: People bound to operational context
personnel.body: Scheduling and assignment authority are established foundations. Personnel management is in active development. Qualification authority is in discovery.

qualifications.name: Qualifications & Certifications
qualifications.purpose: Personnel qualification authority. Not an available qualification system.

assignments.name: Assignments
assignments.purpose: Link personnel to objects and shifts.

operations.title: Day-to-day operational control
operations.body: Security operations, patrols and incident workflows are in active development. Selected offline reporting and patrol workflows are part of the technical foundation. Not every module works offline. No realtime service level is claimed.

patrols.name: Patrols
patrols.purpose: Patrol execution against routes and objects.

offline.name: Selected offline workflows
offline.purpose: Selected offline reporting and patrol workflows. Not every module.

mobile.name: Selected mobile workflows
mobile.purpose: Selected mobile workflows in active development.

security.title: Access, separation and traceability
security.body: Designed around identity, role, tenant and action context. Architecture supports row-level data controls where relevant.
security.chain: Identity → Role → Tenant → Data scope → Action → Audit

billing.name: Bounded billing and payroll data
billing.purpose: Bounded financial, billing and payroll-data foundations. Not a payroll product.

publication.name: Document publication authority
publication.purpose: Who may publish the definitive document.

intelligence.title: Assisted insight. Human decisions.
intelligence.body: AI-assisted report drafting is in active development. Connected analytics is planned. Predictive AI risk analysis is future research. AI does not make autonomous operational decisions.

aiReporting.name: AI Reporting
aiReporting.purpose: AI-assisted report drafting under human review.

predictive.name: Predictive AI risk analysis
predictive.purpose: Risk analysis research for human review. Not an autonomous decision system.

statusModel.title: How capability stages are labeled
statusModel.foundation: Foundation established — technical foundations in the development platform. Not commercial availability.
statusModel.development: Active development — work in progress. Not production-validated.
statusModel.discovery: Discovery / architecture — authority and design questions. Not an available capability.
statusModel.planned: Planned — intended later capability. No release date.
statusModel.future: Future / research — research direction, not delivery.

ctaTitle: Explore how these capabilities map to your operation.
